head.intro: Checklist templates for every stage, the AQL profiles per customer and style, the rules that create inspections by themselves, and a calculator for the sample of a lot.

noAccess.title: You may not open Inspection plans & AQL
noAccess.body: Seeing it needs quality.plans.view, quality.aql.view or quality.triggers.view. The owner or a quality manager grants it in Admin › Roles & permissions.
noAccess.tabTitle: This section is not in your role
noAccess.plans: Seeing the plans needs quality.plans.view (Admin › Roles & permissions).
noAccess.aql: Seeing the AQL profiles needs quality.aql.view (Admin › Roles & permissions).
noAccess.triggers: Seeing when inspections are created needs quality.triggers.view (Admin › Roles & permissions).
noAccess.calculator: The calculator needs quality.aql.view (Admin › Roles & permissions).

held.offline: Offline: the change waits until the connection is back.
held.offlineBanner: Offline — what you see is the last copy; changes wait to be sent.
held.approved: Version {number} is approved and frozen. Start version {next} to change the plan.
held.retired: Version {number} is retired: it is kept as it was.

live.profilesChanged: AQL profiles changed on another screen; your unsaved changes are kept. Read again to see theirs.
live.rulesChanged: The rules changed on another screen; your unsaved changes are kept. Read again to see theirs.
live.planChanged: This plan changed on another screen while you have unsaved changes.

frequency.percentAsk: A share of operations (say how much)

plans.failed: The plans could not be read
plans.noMatchBody: Change the stage, the status or the words searched.
plans.emptyBody: Make a plan with New plan, or start from the leather-apparel starter set: one plan per stage, as drafts to change and approve.
plans.starterNone: Every starter plan is here already.
plans.waitingLine_one: {count} version is waiting for a second person to approve it.
plans.waitingLine_other: {count} versions are waiting for a second person to approve them.
plans.truncated: Only the first 500 plans are shown: narrow the search.

newPlan.title: New plan
newPlan.subtitle: Version 1 is made as a draft by you; a second person approves it before any inspection uses it.
newPlan.stageHint: Where the plan is used: incoming goods, cutting, in-line, end of line, final or returns. It cannot change later.
newPlan.blankHint: An empty checklist: you add the checks.
newPlan.starterHint: A leather-apparel plan of this stage, with its checks and sampling.
newPlan.starterNoneForStage: The starter set has no plan for this stage.
newPlan.copyHint: The checks and sampling of another plan's version.
newPlan.copyNote: A profile of another company is not carried over.
newPlan.codeHint: Capitals, digits, - and _ (FIN-JACKET). Fixed once made.
newPlan.name: Name
newPlan.after: The plan's record opens next: add the checks, set the sampling, then submit it for approval.

plan.code: A plan code is 2 to 40 capitals, digits, - or _, starting with a letter (FIN-JACKET).

chips.typeFirst: Type a code or name first
chips.categoryUnknown: Pick one of the categories offered.

aql.title: AQL profiles
aql.sub: Saved sets of inspection level and AQLs, for the company, a customer, a style or a style of one customer. The most specific one applies when an inspection opens.
aql.tooMany: A company keeps at most 200 profiles.
aql.criticalLocked: Critical is always AQL 0: one critical defect rejects the lot.
aql.criticalLaw: A garment with a safety or compliance defect is never accepted.
aql.emptyBody: Add the company's default profile: general level II, major 2.5, minor 4.0 is the usual start.
aql.name: Name
aql.usedBy: Used by {customers} customers · {styles} styles · {pairs} styles of one customer · {inspections} inspections
aql.failed: The AQL profiles could not be read
aql.whereSub: A profile assigned to a style of one customer wins over the style's, which wins over the customer's, which wins over the company default.
aql.noAssignmentsBody: It applies only where a plan names it, or as the company default.
aql.assignSub: Pick a customer, a style, or both (that style for that customer). An assignment already there is replaced.
aql.assignPick: Pick a customer or a style first.
aql.assignRetired: A retired profile is not assigned.

profiles.code: A profile code is 1 to 40 capitals, digits, . - or _ (AQL-STD).
profiles.name: Name the profile.
profiles.aql: An AQL of ISO 2859-1 Table 2-A, or 0.
profiles.defaultRetired: The company default stays active: make another profile the default first.
profiles.noDefault: Mark one active profile as the company default.
profiles.heldDefault: The company default cannot be retired: make another one the default first.
profiles.heldUsed: Still assigned to customers or styles: end those first.

rules.title: When inspections are created
rules.sub: Rules in order: the first rule that fits opens each kind of record. A rule opens records on its plan's approved version.
rules.noPlans: Make and approve a plan first.
rules.emptyBody: Without a rule, a person opens each inspection. Add a rule to open them when goods arrive or work is scanned.
rules.opened_one: Opened {n} record in the last 30 days (last {last}).
rules.opened_other: Opened {n} records in the last 30 days (last {last}).
rules.openedNone: Opened nothing in the last 30 days.
rules.failed: The rules could not be read
rules.dialogSub: The list is saved together with Save on the page; Preview shows what this rule would have done last month.
rules.planHint: Only plans of the stages this event can open.
rules.activeOff: The rule is off (kept, opens nothing)
rules.previewAsk: Preview counts what this rule would have created in the last 30 days, with the other rules in their places.
rules.planStage: This event cannot open a plan of that stage.
rules.noApproved: The plan has no approved version: approve one, or keep the rule off.
rules.frequency: This event does not take that frequency.
rules.firstPieceInLine: First piece is for in-line plans only.
rules.chipKind: This event never knows that kind: the chip would never fit.

calc.title: AQL calculator
calc.sub: Try a lot size and a level, or a profile: the code letter, the sample and each class's accept and reject numbers (ISO 2859-1, normal inspection).
calc.profileHint: Fills the level and the AQLs; change them to try others.
calc.noProfile: No profile (type the level and the AQLs)
calc.typedWins: Changed from the profile: the values typed are used.
calc.nothingSaved: Nothing is saved: this is a calculator.

checks.title: Checks
checks.emptyBody: Add a check: pass / fail, a measurement, a count, a choice, free text, a photo, a signature or an instruction to read.
checks.tooMany: A version holds at most {max} checks.
checks.codeHint: Kept from version to version: results compare by it.
checks.classHint: A failed critical check fails the inspection.
checks.mandatoryLabel: Mandatory (the inspection is not signed without it)
checks.nominalHint: Leave nominal and tolerance blank to read the style's size chart.
checks.codePattern: A check code is 2 to 40 capitals, digits or _, starting with a letter (CE_MARK).
checks.nominalBad: A number from 0, with at most 3 decimals (58.5).
checks.toleranceBad: A tolerance from 0, with at most 3 decimals (1.0).
checks.codeTwice: {code} is on the list twice: each check once.
checks.measureBoth: A measurement has both a nominal and a tolerance, or neither (the size chart).
checks.choicesTwo: A choice offers at least two answers.
checks.choiceLong: An answer has at most {max} characters.

note.title: Note for the approver
note.label: What changed and why
note.hint: The approver reads it beside the comparison.

bench.title: On the bench
bench.nothingToCheck: Nothing takes a result yet: a plan needs at least one check to answer.
bench.frozen: This version is frozen as approved.
bench.apiProblems_one: {count} problem the server sees: save to see where.
bench.apiProblems_other: {count} problems the server sees: save to see where.
bench.saveToCheck: Your changes are not saved yet: save to check them again.

sampling.aqlHint: The sample comes from the lot size and the profile's level and AQLs.
sampling.fixedHint: The same number every time, whatever the lot.
sampling.profileChain: The one that applies (style for this customer, style, customer, company default)
sampling.profileChainHint: Picked when a record opens, from the style and the customer.
sampling.profileNamedHint: This plan always uses this profile.
sampling.profilesForbidden: The profiles are not in your role (quality.aql.view): the one saved stays.
sampling.namedRetired: {code} is retired: pick another profile before the approval.
sampling.fixedSizeHint: At most 10,000; never more than the lot.
sampling.fixedProblem: A fixed sample is 1 to {max} units.
sampling.frequencyHint: A rule of When inspections are created takes this as its start.
sampling.rulesWin_one: {count} rule names this plan: its own frequency wins.
sampling.rulesWin_other: {count} rules name this plan: their own frequency wins.
sampling.percent: A share of the operations is 1 to 100%.
sampling.everyNth: Every Nth bundle: N is 1 to {max}.
sampling.stopSETTING: As the company's quality rules say
sampling.stopSTOPHint: The inspection fails as soon as a class reaches its reject number.
sampling.stopFINISHHint: Every unit of the sample is inspected, even after a reject.
sampling.exampleLotHint: Only to try: nothing is saved.
sampling.exampleDefault: The company default {code} · {name} (a lot with no style or customer profile)
sampling.exampleFixed: A fixed sample: {n} units every time.
sampling.exampleNoRead: The profiles cannot be read here: no example.
sampling.exampleNoDefault: No company default profile yet: add one in AQL profiles.

applies.title: Applies to
applies.sub: Where this plan is used: none means every style of its stage. A rule of When inspections are created can narrow it further.
applies.subIncoming: Where this plan is used: none means every material received. A rule of When inspections are created can narrow it further.
applies.name: Name
applies.previewAfterSave: Save to see how many it applies to.
applies.how: A chip of each kind must fit: a style chip and a customer chip mean that style for that customer.

versions.title: Versions
versions.sub: Every version, frozen on each record that ran on it.
versions.againstNothing: The first version: every check is new.
versions.noRecords: No record has run on it yet.
versions.recordsTable: The newest records on this version

compare.movedNote: Now at another place in the list.

record.ownerClear: I am no longer the owner
record.waiting: Version {number} waits for a second person to approve it (asked by {who}, {when}).

submit.already: Already submitted: a second person approves it.

approve.title: Approve {code} version {number}
approve.subtitle: Approving freezes this version: new records open on it, the version in force is retired, records keep the version they ran on.
approve.noDraft: There is no draft to approve.
approve.author: You wrote version {number}: a second person approves it.
approve.editor: You changed version {number}: a person who did not change it approves it.
approve.notReady_one: {count} thing stops the approval: fix it first.
approve.notReady_other: {count} things stop the approval: fix them first.
approve.allNew_one: The first version: {count} check, all new
approve.allNew_other: The first version: {count} checks, all new
approve.same: Nothing changed from the version in force.
approve.whoMay: Anyone with quality.plans.approve who neither wrote nor changed this draft
approve.ruleAuthorBroken: You wrote version {number}: you may not approve it.
approve.ruleEditorMet: You did not change this draft.
approve.ruleEditorBroken: You changed version {number}: you may not approve it.
approve.retiresNote: Version {number}, in force now, is retired in the same step.
approve.firstNote: No version is in force yet: this one becomes it.
approve.code: Approving is an e-signature: it asks a fresh code from your authenticator app.

retire.title: Retire version {number}
retire.approvedSub: No new record opens on it; records that ran on it keep it. Until another version is approved, the plan has none in force.
retire.draftSub: The draft is set aside and kept.
retire.reasonShort: Say why, in a few words.
retire.rulesUsePlan_one: {count} active rule uses this plan: switch it off first.
retire.rulesUsePlan_other: {count} active rules use this plan: switch them off first.

stepUp.title: Confirm with your authenticator app
stepUp.approve: Approving a plan version is an e-signature: confirm it with a fresh code.

done.starter_one: {count} starter plan added as a draft.
done.ownerCleared: The plan has no owner now.
done.newVersion: Version {number} started as a draft, copied from the version in force.
done.approved: Version {number} approved: new records open on it.

print.title: Inspection checklist
print.nothingBody: Open a plan and pick Print the checklist.

problem.signedOut: Your session ended: sign in again.
problem.forbidden: This is not in your role.
problem.notFound: Not found: it may have been removed.
problem.conflict: Refused: it clashes with what is stored.
problem.stale: Someone changed it in the meantime: read it again, then apply your change.
problem.invalid: Refused as it is: check the fields.
problem.rateLimited: Too many tries: wait a little.
problem.unavailable: No answer from the server: try again.
problem.contract: The answer did not match this screen: reload the page.
problem.internal: Something went wrong on the server.
problem.profileRefused: The server refused a profile change (a code already taken, the default, or a profile still in use). {count} changes were saved before.
problem.assignSame: This profile is assigned there already.

refusal.AUTHOR: You wrote this version: a second person approves it.
refusal.EDITOR: You changed this version: a person who did not change it approves it.
refusal.NOT_DRAFT: Only a draft can be changed or approved.
refusal.NOT_READY: The version is not ready: fix what stops the approval.
refusal.PROFILE_RETIRED: The profile it names is retired: pick another one.
refusal.DRAFT_EXISTS: A draft is being written already.
refusal.CODE_TAKEN: That code is taken in this company.
refusal.RULES_USE_PLAN: An active rule uses this plan: switch the rule off first.
refusal.TOO_MANY: The company keeps the most it may: remove some first.
refusal.NO_APPROVED_VERSION: The plan has no approved version: approve one, or keep the rule off.
